definitions.explanation: The anatomical term for the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist. Paired with {上腕|じょうわん} (upper arm) when describing arm anatomy.

examples.japanese: {前腕|ぜんわん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{前腕|ぜんわん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My forearm muscles hurt from the heavy luggage.

examples.japanese: ⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前腕|ぜんわん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that forearm strength is important in tennis.

notes:
The anatomical term for the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist. Used in medical and fitness contexts, often alongside ⟦{上腕|じょうわん}→上腕：29742_jouwan⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前腕|ぜんわん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧: forearm muscles
- {前腕|ぜんわん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to strengthen the forearms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上腕|じょうわん}→上腕：29742_jouwan⟧: upper arm — the part above the elbow
- ⟦{手首|てくび}→手首：01000_tekubi⟧: wrist — the joint at the end of the forearm
